reading.body:
This record is an unverified OpenStreetMap point in Italy, not a confirmed data center, and it carries zero megawatts.

The entry is tagged telecom=data_center and named iZOOM.it, a name whose embedded ".it" suffix is a common pattern among Italian web-hosting and domain-registration businesses. That makes a small Italian hosting or IT-services operation plausible. It does not make it a data center in the sense that matters for AI, which is a building with contracted power and known capacity.

The megawatt field reads zero, and no operator, website, or business registration was confirmed. The only source is a tagging review. A facility that cannot be tied to an operator or a power figure cannot be counted toward any compute estimate, and this one should not be.

What the data does not cover is nearly everything: actual scale, service offering, operating status, and whether the site is a data center at all rather than an office or a colocation reseller. The nearest airport, Parma at 18.7 miles, is the only geographic anchor. Treat this as a research lead, not a supply figure.
